title: Fort Heritage Precinct

services.name: Guided Tours
services.desc: The Fort Heritage Precinct is a beautiful place to spend a morning or afternoon! Join us for a guided tour and explore the 1937 Warden’s House, the 1875 North-West Mounted Police Fort, and the Historical Village. Our friendly and knowledgeable guides will tailor your tour experience to your interests from start to finish. We ask that all groups of 10 or more individuals call to arrange their tour in advance. This way we can ensure we have adequate staff available to make your experience the best it can be! For a full site tour (approximately 2 hours), please arrive before 2:00 pm.
